name: ICANotes vs TherapyNotes
title: ICANotes vs TherapyNotes: Mental Health EHR Comparison (2026)
description: Compare ICANotes and TherapyNotes for mental health practices. See differences in documentation speed, prescribing, pricing, support, and which EHR is best for therapists vs psychiatrists.

summary.bottom_line: ICANotes excels at documentation speed with its unique 75,000+ phrase library—ideal for psychiatrists and high-volume practices. TherapyNotes offers simpler workflows, exceptional 24/7 support, and lower pricing—better for therapists who prioritize ease of use over documentation speed.

key_differences.documentation_speed: ICANotes (fastest with phrase library) vs TherapyNotes (standard)
key_differences.complexity: ICANotes (more features, steeper learning) vs TherapyNotes (simpler)

sections.heading: ICANotes vs TherapyNotes: Overview
sections.content: ICANotes and TherapyNotes are both purpose-built behavioral health EHRs, but they emphasize different strengths. ICANotes was designed by a practicing psychiatrist and features a unique 75,000+ phrase content library for rapid note assembly—users report significantly faster documentation. TherapyNotes is known for its simplicity, exceptional 24/7 customer support, and straightforward workflows. Both are HIPAA-compliant with solid core EHR features.

sections.heading: Documentation Speed: The Key Difference
sections.content: ICANotes' phrase library is its defining feature. Instead of typing free-text notes, clinicians click to select pre-written clinical phrases that auto-generate narrative, audit-ready documentation. This is particularly valuable for psychiatrists documenting complex medication management visits—the system helps maintain thoroughness while dramatically reducing time. TherapyNotes uses structured, clinician-built templates that are well-organized but require more manual entry. For high-volume practices where documentation time matters, ICANotes has a clear advantage.

sections.heading: Customer Support
sections.content: TherapyNotes wins decisively on customer support with 24/7 phone and email availability on all plans—a rarity in the EHR market. TherapyNotes also offers free data import from other EMRs and unlimited training resources. ICANotes provides business hours support. For practices that value being able to reach help anytime (especially important during evening/weekend sessions), TherapyNotes' support availability is a major advantage.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: TherapyNotes has simpler, more predictable pricing: $69/month solo, $79/month for groups plus $50/additional clinician. ICANotes pricing is more complex, ranging from $35/month for basic to $213/month for full-featured plans. The right choice depends on your needs—ICANotes' basic tier is cheaper, but comparable feature sets often land at similar price points.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Match the platform to your clinical role:

recommendations.when: You're a psychiatrist or high-volume prescriber, documentation speed is your top priority, you want automatic E&M coding, you need 100+ built-in rating scales, or you value the phrase library approach to rapid notes

You're a therapist or counselor who prioritizes simplicity, you want 24/7 customer support, you prefer straightforward pricing, you're comfortable with standard documentation workflows, or you're switching from another EMR (free import)
Both are solid behavioral health EHRs—the documentation style preference (phrase library vs structured templates) and support availability should drive your decision

faqs.q: Is ICANotes or TherapyNotes faster for documentation?
faqs.a: ICANotes is generally faster due to its unique 75,000+ phrase library. Instead of typing, clinicians click to select pre-written clinical phrases that auto-generate notes. This approach significantly reduces documentation time, especially for complex psychiatric visits. TherapyNotes uses structured templates that are well-organized but require more manual entry.

faqs.q: Which has better customer support: ICANotes or TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: TherapyNotes has significantly better support availability with 24/7 phone and email on all plans. ICANotes provides business hours support. If you need help during evening or weekend sessions, TherapyNotes' round-the-clock availability is a major advantage.

faqs.q: Is ICANotes or TherapyNotes better for psychiatrists?
faqs.a: ICANotes is generally better for psychiatrists. It was designed by a practicing psychiatrist with over 100 built-in rating scales, automatic E&M coding, and integrated e-prescribing. The phrase library is particularly valuable for documenting complex medication management visits. TherapyNotes works for prescribers but isn't as optimized for psychiatric workflows.

faqs.q: Which is cheaper: ICANotes or TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: ICANotes' basic tier ($35/month) is cheaper than TherapyNotes ($69/month). However, ICANotes' full-featured plans go up to $213/month. For comparable feature sets, pricing is often similar. TherapyNotes has more predictable pricing ($50/additional clinician) while ICANotes pricing is more complex.
